Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week pilot. We wrapped yesterday and I wanted to share a short summary of the results and a quick ask from our marketing team if you’re open to it.

Quick recap (aggregate across the three prod-ish endpoints you tested):
- Average p95 latency improved from ~610ms to ~320ms (roughly 47% improvement).
- Cost per 1k tokens reduced by ~27% after batching + KV cache adjustments.
- Peak throughput increased by 2.0x under your typical concurrency pattern.
- No user-facing errors during test; observed reliability of 99.92% across run windows.

Attached is the two-page pilot_summary with charts and the test config we used. [Attachment: pilot_summary_2026-06-24.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

Marketing asked whether Novus would be willing to: 1) provide a short quote (1–2 sentences) about the pilot impact we can include in a short customer spotlight; and 2) do a quick 15–20 minute call next week so Hannah can capture a few on-record lines and agree on wording. We’d only publish anything with your sign-off.

If you’re comfortable, an example quote we could shorten: "Redwood helped us cut inference costs by ~27% and halved our tail latency, which improved user search responsiveness across high-traffic periods." Feel free to edit or reject — we want something that reads true to your experience.

Suggested times for a 20-min slot: Tue 6/29 10–11am PT, Wed 6/30 10–11am PT, or Thu 7/1 2–4pm PT. Happy to coordinate with Markus if he should join.

If better, you can just reply with a short quote in-line and we’ll take it from there.

Appreciate the partnership — excited about what you built here.

Best,
Ben
